# The clearing: a 12-sided slab 10 m across (top at z 0) with the earth, leaf litter and path
# painted in one texture, dark earth sides, a rocky underside tapering to a point. Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Top --vertices 12 --radius 5.0 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 -0.25
material new Ground --base-color 1 1 1
material new Dirt --base-color 0.286 0.302 0.494 --no-slot
active Top
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
material assign Dirt
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Ground base-color textures/ground_48.png
add mesh cone --name Under --vertices 12 --radius1 0.8 --radius2 4.9 --depth 2.2 --location 0 0 -1.6
material assign Dirt
active Under
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < 0.5"
randomize --amount 0.35 --seed 2
mode object
select all
shade flat
export ground.glb
